description: 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원_자동차 배출가스 및 소음인증 정보 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원. 환경부 국립환경과학원에서 자동차 배출가스 및 소음 인증에 대한 정보를 제공하며, 항목으로는 차종, 배출가스인증일, 배출가스인증번호, 소음인증일, 소음인증번호, 사용연료, 배출가스/소음. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원. Its tags are 자동차환경인증, 배출가스인증, 소음인증, 이륜자동차, 상용차. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
